statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The clinical documentation provided sufficiently justifies the need for this specific diagnostic procedure at this time
The service was denied with denial reason code CO-50
The denial was based on the service not being deemed medically necessary under current Federal Medicare guidelines
